title: Cute, but not entirely practical.
text:
Cute, but not entirely practical.. They're fine if you want to hang dresses or such without straps. Also, this is preferable for smaller children since the hangers are a bit narrower than other children's hangers we have.

I ordered this because of the dope glitter. I wish the metal hanger spun, but it's fixed in place (not a big deal, but would've been nice).

The indents for straps is very narrow; whenever I hang clothes with straps, the straps tend to fall out.
